method: LLM reviewer read every decoded new-store output against its bound facts and structured payload. Contextual human-equivalent judgment; not an independent human study, formal validator, generated-output repair or conversion evaluation.
rubric: A direct wrong name/color/price or unsupported benefit is a substantive factual failure. No observed direct contradiction was found.
Missing essential/incoherent generated text fails qualitative usability; correct structured metadata does not make the title In usable.
Readable product captions, reordered factual relations, price omission with exact structured price, harmless inflection and title punctuation may be useful despite narrow pilot grammar rejection.
A more precise unproven component claim is set aside for verification even when plausible. Cushioned earcups is not asserted proven false.
Operational rate requires every required generated field to be usable as shown, with original metadata, without any repair. No ranking/image/personalization quality inference.

summary.sampling: exhaustive: all8 new-store evaluation arms,20 fields each; frozen/failed-daypack texts not qualitatively reviewed
summary.timingInterpretation: Recorded original serialized copy-stage attempt times only. Offline usability is not strict accepted-result latency, browser paint, ranking+copy latency or a changed benchmark.
